description: This file contains a script for testing and comparing the performance of LiteLLM and OpenAI SDKs by making multiple asynchronous completion requests.

methods.name: openai_completion
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous chat completion request using the OpenAI client.

methods.name: router_completion
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous chat completion request using the litellm router client.

methods.name: proxy_completion_non_streaming
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous chat completion request via the litellm proxy client without streaming.

methods.name: loadtest_fn
methods.description: Executes multiple concurrent load test tasks to measure performance of the chat completion requests.
